cd /data && Rscript -e 'd1<-read.csv("summary_stats_LSS1.csv"); d2<-read.csv("summary_stats_LSS2.csv"); cat("LSS1 walk_path_speed medians:
"); print(c(Walk=median(d1$walk_path_speed,na.rm=TRUE), Search=median(d1$search_path_speed,na.rm=TRUE))); cat("LSS1 straightness medians:

"); print(c(Walk=median(d2$walk_path_speed,na.rm=TRUE), Search=median(d2$search_path_speed,na.rm=TRUE))); cat("LSS2 straightness medians:
"); print(c(Walk=median(d2$walk_straightness,na.rm=TRUE), Search=median(d2$search_straightness,na.rm=TRUE)));'
